messages:
liam (new-hire): Hi team - Liam here, joining the rotation Thu night. Quick preflight: runbook access, OpsGenie routing to phone, and where do I find the one-line exec template?
ruth (oncall-lead): Welcome! Runbooks: Confluence > Reliability > Oncall Runbooks. Exec template is under Communication templates. If attachments or macros 403, post your SSO and @dan will add ACLs. OpsGenie -> ensure push + SMS and device enrolled in MDM.
dan (sre): Added liam@redwood.com to runbook attachments. Also FYI we pushed a small change this morning that may break the 'mitigation snippets' macro for new viewers. If you see an empty box, refresh twice or use the 'View as anonymous' toggle in Confluence to un-stub the macro. We'll patch later.
liam (new-hire): Thanks, I see the page but the 'Fast Mitigations' box is empty.
dan (sre): Yep that's the macro bug. For now open the raw page (three dots -> 'View Storage Format') or use this direct gist: https://internal.gist/reliability/fast-mitigations (shortcuts).
docs-bot: Note: We've filed docs ticket DOCS-482: Confluence macro rendering for runbook snippets.
liam (new-hire): Re: OpsGenie push - test shows 'delivery failed'. My device is a company phone enrolled in MDM.
ops-bot: ACTION: Device liam-phone pending MDM background approvals. Approve: https://mdm.redwood.internal/approve?device=liam-phone
liam (new-hire): Approved. Re-sent test, got push.
ruth (oncall-lead): Good. A few onboarding rules: 1) first two rotations are shadowed (you'll be paired automatically) 2) when acking a page post one-line status + next action in thread 3) use the incident template verbatim for exec notices; if unsure set Sev2 and escalate.
liam (new-hire): Quick technical Q: running `curl http://model-ingress.internal/health` from laptop returns 502, but jumpbox returns 200. Any quick checks?
dan (sre): Likely missing internal route. Run `tailscale status` and `sudo ip route | grep 10.0.0.0/8`. If route missing re-auth tailscale or use `ssh jumpbox` and test. If you need a temporary reverse-proxy we can port-forward: `kubectl port-forward svc/model-ingress -n model-serving 8080:80 &` from the jumpbox.
liam (new-hire): tailscale connected but route missing. Re-auth fixed it.
ruth (oncall-lead): Also, for debugging you can request a 4h Vault debug token (limited scope) via the runbook: `vault request-token --purpose=oncall-debug`. Don't share it.
liam (new-hire): Good to know. One more: if alerts flood, what's the immediate action?
dan (sre): Short: mute the noisy alert group (runbook > Commands -> 'silence noisy alerts'), post in #eng-oncall 'muted group X', then escalate to infra if it's platform-level.
liam (new-hire): Can I swap my second shadow date? I need Sat night off.
ruth (oncall-lead): Swaps ok with 24h notice and volunteer. Post availability in #eng-oncall-swap and ping me. Pagerbot will confirm once swap happens.
pagerbot: Scheduled: Liam shadow with Ruth - 2026-08-12 22:00-06:00 UTC.
liam (new-hire): Thanks everyone, excited to get started :grinning:
